about_the_game:
There’s an old rumor about an abandoned hospital where a ghostly figure dressed as a nurse roams the halls.
To uncover the truth behind the eerie tale, you and your friend decide to visit the hospital yourselves.
Before you realize it, you’ve stepped into an otherworldly dimension.

Now trapped inside, you must run, hide, and outwit the terrifying Nurse Baba who relentlessly chases intruders.
Search the hospital to find hidden keys and unravel the story of what truly happened in this cursed place.
Only by understanding Baba’s lingering regrets can you hope to escape.

Key Features

Run & Hide

  • Evade the terrifying Baba by running through the hospital corridors.

  • Hide in lockers or behind objects to survive when danger is near.

Explore

  • Discover notes, records, and clues scattered throughout the hospital.

  • Use keys to unlock new areas and uncover the hidden past of the hospital.

The Nurse Baba

  • No matter where you go, she’ll follow.

  • But if you observe her closely, you might learn about her past and the life she once lived.

Replayable

  • Even if you get caught, you can quickly restart from your last checkpoint.

  • Never give up—the truth is waiting for those who persist.

Multiple Endings

  • Your choices and what you uncover determine the ending.

  • Will you discover the true ending and free both yourself and Baba?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) 以降
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 以上
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 以上、もしくは同等のDirectX 11対応GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 互換のサウンドデバイス
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) 以降
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 第8世代 以上、または Ryzen 5 2600 以上
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 以上、または同等のDirectX 11対応GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 互換のサウンドデバイス

short_description: A 2D adventure horror game where you are chased by an old lady. You get lost in a hospital. Can you escape without being caught by the old lady?
